name: TC-320: an item the owner marks sold out disappears from the storefront menu and comes back when restored
description: Storefront shows the seeded item card with its price. Owner (Menu tab) switches it OFF → 'Mark sold out'. Reloading the storefront: the card is gone (template-wind filters outOfStock items out of the menu grid). Owner switches it back ON → card is back.
descriptionHtml: Storefront shows the seeded item card with its price. Owner (Menu tab) switches it OFF → 'Mark sold out'. Reloading the storefront: the card is gone (template-wind filters outOfStock items out of the menu grid). Owner switches it back ON → card is back.
